Whisk the Greek yoghurt with the mayonnaise, then incorporate the mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper until a smooth and glossy sauce forms.
Cut the eggs into dice and add them to the salad bowl.
Pour the sauce and mix with a spatula, using broad movements from the bottom, to coat without crushing.
Cover and let rest in the refrigerator for two to four hours. Adjust the seasoning before serving: the cold mutes the salt.

title: Mango in three quick desserts
intro: The same mango puree, three textures: the quality of the fruit does all the work, so choose a ripe mango and taste it before blending.
ing: Banana sliced into rounds and frozen for at least 4 to 5 hours
titane: Dry-roast the granola (without oil, to enhance the flavors) in a titanium pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir constantly. As soon as it starts to smell nutty, transfer it from the pan to a cold plate: the residual heat from the metal would continue to cook it and cause bitterness. The resulting crunch stays in the yogurt much longer than granola straight from the package.
steps: Plan ahead: the banana must freeze for 4 to 5 hours; slice it the day before or early in the morning.

The day before or in the morning, slice the banana into one-centimetre rounds, spread them on a plate without touching and place in the freezer for 4 to 5 hours. A still-soft banana will give a liquid sorbet.
Toast the granola as indicated above, then let it cool completely.
Verrine. Pour a yogurt into the bottom of each serving glass. Pour 200 g of mango puree over it, tilting the glass slightly to obtain a clear dividing line. Sprinkle with granola at the last moment.

Smoothie. In the blender bowl, combine 200 g of mango puree, the coconut milk, the ice cubes and the lime juice. Blend in short bursts then continuously until a smooth texture, without ice shards. Serve immediately.

Minute sorbet. Blend the frozen banana with the remaining 200 g of mango puree and the lemon juice. Stop as soon as the mixture becomes creamy and takes on the texture of Italian ice cream: beyond that, the heat from the blades makes it collapse. Serve immediately or place in the freezer for 10 minutes.

title: Fruit ice cream, no added sugar
intro: It all comes down to the amount of water: too little and the ice cream becomes a hard block, too much and the fruit disappears.

ing.note: raspberry, mango (your choice or a mix)

ing: The juice of half a lemon
titane: No heat here, so no need to overmix: the trick is to measure the water precisely. Allow approximately 5 cl for 600 g of fruit, added in two stages, judging the texture between each addition. The purée should flow from the blender in a thick ribbon, never a thin stream. It's this density that creates an ice cream that's irresistibly satisfying.
steps: Plan ahead: the ice cream takes a minimum of 6 hours to freeze, allow this time before serving.
Hull, pit and cut the fruit into regular pieces. Place them in the blender bowl or in a tall container if you are using an immersion blender.
Add the juice of the half lemon and half the water.
Blend for 2 minutes, until smooth and homogeneous in texture, with no grainy bits or visible fibres. Add the remaining water only if the machine struggles to turn.
Pour into ice cream moulds, leaving half a centimetre from the top: the mixture will expand as it freezes. Tap the moulds on the work surface to remove any air bubbles.
Place in the freezer for a minimum of 6 hours, until completely set. To unmould, run the mould under lukewarm water for 5 seconds.

title: Puff pastry cones with whipped cream and strawberries
intro: It all comes down to two things: puff pastry baked long enough to stay crisp once filled, and whipped cream stiff enough not to make the pastry soggy.

ing.note: plus a little something for the finishing touch

titane: Grease the conical molds and then wipe off the excess with a paper towel. A very thin film of grease is enough: too much grease will cause the pastry to slip during baking and the cone to collapse. And never unmold while still warm, as the puff pastry will tear.
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Grease the six metal cone molds, then remove the excess grease.
Unroll the puff pastry and cut it into 2 cm wide strips.
Wrap each strip around a cone starting from the tip, overlapping the edges by 3 to 4 mm with each turn. Stop before the edge of the mold.
Brush the pastry with egg yolk, being careful not to let it drip onto the metal: it would stick during baking.
Bake for 17 to 20 minutes, until the puff pastry is amber and dry to the touch.
Allow to cool completely on the baking sheet, including the molds.
Remove from the mold by gently rotating the metal cone. The dough should detach without resistance.
Whip the cream (whisk it to aerate and firm it up) with the icing sugar and vanilla. Stop when the whisk leaves a clean trail and the tip stands straight.
Fill a piping bag fitted with a star nozzle and pipe (place under regular pressure) the whipped cream into each cone, interspersing pieces of strawberries as you go.
Finish with a rosette of whipped cream when opening, a few strawberries on top and a dusting of icing sugar. Serve within the hour.

title: Raw courgette tagliatelle, feta cheese and sesame-ginger sauce
intro: It all comes down to the thickness of the cut: too thin, the courgette releases its water and falls apart; well-calibrated, it remains crunchy under the sauce.
titane: Slice the whole zucchini against the mandoline, stopping at the seedy core. This central, more moist part will make the salad soggy: save it for soup or broth. And never salt the strips in advance; the soy sauce already provides all the necessary salt.
steps: Cut the courgettes lengthwise into quarters. Pass each quarter over a mandoline or under a vegetable peeler blade to obtain tagliatelles (long and flexible strands). Transfer them to a large salad bowl.
Slice the spring onion into fine rings, including white and green parts. Chop the herbs at the last moment. If using chilli, remove the seeds and cut it into slices.
Grate the garlic and ginger finely over a bowl so that they blend into the sauce.
Add the two oils, rice vinegar, soy sauce and honey to it. Whisk until the mixture thickens slightly and stops separating.
Pour the sauce over the courgettes. Crumble the feta by hand into irregular pieces, add the spring onion, sesame, chilli and herbs.
Mix with your fingertips or using two forks, lifting rather than stirring: the strands must remain intact.
Cover and leave to rest for 20 minutes in the refrigerator. The courgette softens, the sauce soaks in, the ginger loses its bite.

title: Breakable frozen yogurt in a sheet
intro: It all comes down to thickness: too thick a layer results in a block that is hard to break and cold in the mouth, a thin layer remains neat and melts just right.
ing: The zest of half a lime
titane: No pan here, but the same surface logic applies: work on a cold, perfectly flat surface. Place the empty baking sheet in the freezer for ten minutes before spreading the mixture on it. Contact with the already frozen metal immediately sets the base, the fruit stays on the surface instead of sinking, and the sheet breaks into clean shards rather than soft pieces.
steps: Plan ahead: the sheet will spend 3 hours in the freezer, organize your afternoon accordingly.
Place the sheet and the whisk bowl in the freezer for ten minutes. Then line the sheet with parchment paper.
Whip the cold heavy cream until well chilled (whisk it until it holds on the whisk without being grainy). Stop as soon as it forms a soft peak.

Fold in the yogurts in three batches, using a spatula, lifting the mixture from the bottom. Do not aim for perfect homogeneity: a few marbling streaks are welcome. Do not add sugar, the yogurts already contain some.
Spread the mixture onto the sheet in an even layer, 1 cm maximum. Smooth with an offset spatula.

Scatter the fruit, pistachios and granola. Drizzle the almond butter in spaced drops, then drag them with a knife tip to create marbling. Finish with lime zest, chopped mint and white chocolate shavings.
Freeze for a minimum of 3 hours, the sheet lying flat.
Remove it 5 to 10 minutes before serving, just enough time for the mixture to lose its rock-hard consistency.
Peel off the parchment paper, break the sheet into irregular shards and serve immediately.

title: Shrimp and fresh herb rice rolls
intro: Everything hinges on the rice paper: if soaked for too long, it sticks and tears; if taken out of the water too soon, it finishes softening upon contact with the filling and remains intact.
titane: No pan here, no heat source. The technique is similar: the soaking water should be lukewarm, barely warmer than your fingertip. Count 15 to 20 seconds, no more. The sheet will still be slightly firm to the touch; place it on a damp cloth, and it will finish softening on its own while you add the filling. It's the same principle as removing meat from the pan before it's cooked to your liking and letting it rest.
steps: Prepare the sauce first. In a bowl, loosen the peanut butter with the lime juice. Add the zest, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger. Whisk until smooth, then emulsify (thicken by whisking) with the hot water, one spoonful at a time, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Set aside.
Arrange the fillings in front of you, each in its own container. Assembling them cold is quick: you shouldn't have to leave your work surface.
Fill a large container with lukewarm water. Immerse a sheet of rice paper for 15 to 20 seconds, rotating it. It should remain slightly stiff.
Remove it (place it outside the container) and lay it flat on a clean, damp cloth. Smooth it with your fingertips.

On the lower third of the sheet, first place a lettuce leaf, then the carrots and herbs. Arrange the halved prawns and avocado slices on top, rounded side down: these will be visible through the paper.

Fold the bottom edge over the filling and press down, pulling towards you to expel any air. Turn the roll halfway around, fold both sides inwards, and then finish rolling. The roll should feel firm to the touch, without the pastry stretching so much as to turn white.
Place the rolls on a platter without letting them touch. Serve within the hour, with the sauce on the side.

title: Gratin-style courgette rolls with shredded chicken
intro: It all comes down to how well the galette holds together: a layer of melted cheese that binds the zucchini strips together and allows them to be rolled without splitting.
titane: The galette is rolled the moment it comes out of the oven. If it's too hot, it will stretch and tear; if it's too cold, it will break cleanly. Let it rest on the baking sheet for two minutes, then place a finger in the center: the surface should be soft and warm, more elastic than liquid. Then lift the parchment paper from one long side and let it push the rolling pin in front of you, without ever pulling on the galette itself.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C, with fan setting. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Cut the courgettes into 2 mm thick slices lengthwise using a mandoline or vegetable peeler. Salt them lightly and let them drain (release water through salting) for 10 minutes in a colander, then pat them dry carefully. A damp slice prevents the galette from setting.
Spread the grated cheese over the parchment in a regular rectangle of approximately 30 × 25 cm, with no holes or thick spots.
Arrange the courgette slices on top, barely overlapping, all in the same direction. Drizzle with a thin stream of olive oil, sprinkle with Herbes de Provence, salt and pepper.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes. The galette is ready when the edges brown and the cheese no longer bubbles in the centre.
While cooking, dice the peppers, peeled red onion and deseeded tomatoes into small cubes. Mix them with the shredded chicken, spices and chopped coriander. Salt.
Remove the baking sheet and wait two minutes. Spread the filling in a band on the longest side closest to you, about 5 cm wide, and add the hand-torn mozzarella on top.
Roll tightly using the parchment paper as you would a sushi mat. Let the roll rest for 5 minutes, seam side down, before slicing it into 4 cm thick pieces with a serrated knife.

title: Invisible zucchini cake
intro: It all comes down to the thickness of the slices: too thick, they remain courgettes; thin enough, they disappear into the mixture (liquid blend of eggs, cream and flour) and leave only a layered vegetable.
titane: This one goes in the oven, in a baking dish: the height and set consistency aren't replicated in a pan. The key is elsewhere. Mix the slices by hand, not with a spoon, lifting from the bottom of the bowl and separating the slices between your fingers. The mixture needs to flow between each slice; otherwise, the cake will bake in two separate layers: a flan on the bottom, a pile of zucchini on top.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Lightly grease a 16cm diameter cake tin and line the base with baking paper.
Wash the zucchini, leaving the skin on. Slice them very thinly using a mandoline, or with a knife if you're confident in your hand. Aim for 1 to 2 mm thick. Set aside in a large salad bowl.
Beat the eggs with the fine salt, pepper and fleur de sel until the mixture is homogeneous.
Pour in the liquid cream and whisk.
Add the flour all at once and whisk until the lumps disappear. The mixture should remain fluid, similar to pancake batter.
Stir in the olive oil, then the grated cheese if you are using it.
Pour the mixture over the slices. Mix by hand for a good minute, separating any slices stuck together.
Transfer into the mold in small quantities, pressing down with the back of a spoon after each addition. The goal is to eliminate air between the layers.
Bake for 45 minutes. The top should be golden brown and a knife inserted into the center should come out clean.
Allow to cool completely in the pan before unmolding. When hot, the cake tears; when cold, it cuts cleanly.

title: Instant frozen fruit ice cream
intro: It's all about the temperature: fruits as hard as pebbles and just enough dairy for the blades to grip, not a spoonful more.

ing.note: peach, raspberry, strawberry), cut into pieces

titane: Before blending, dry-roast the granola in the titanium pan over medium heat for two to three minutes, stirring constantly. The flakes will turn from light brown to golden and release a nutty aroma. Immediately transfer the granola from the pan to a cold plate: the titanium retains heat and the granola would continue to cook. This warm crunch contrasting with the ice cream is the key to this dessert.
steps: Plan ahead: freeze the fruit the day before, start the day before.
The day before, cut the fruit into regular 2 cm pieces. Spread them on a baking sheet in a single layer, without touching each other, and place in the freezer. Once frozen, gather them in a box.
Toast the granola in a pan as indicated above. Set aside at room temperature.
Pour the frozen fruit into the blender bowl. Add only one third of the yogurt.

Blend in short pulses. The mixture will first become crumbly, then clump around the blades. Scrape the sides, add the dairy product spoonful by spoonful until you obtain a creamy and glossy texture that holds a ribbon on the spatula. Allow five minutes in total.
Serve immediately in chilled bowls, granola on top. If the ice cream has softened too much, return it to the freezer for fifteen minutes before plating.

title: Strawberry marble cookies with a cheesecake center
intro: It all comes down to the heart: the cream must be frozen solid before being added to the dough, otherwise it leaks during baking and the cookie spreads.
titane: Seal the center. Place the frozen cheesecake disc in the center of the dough, fold the edges up like a purse, then roll the ball between your palms until no seam is visible. A dough sealed all the way around retains the filling; a dough that's simply folded over allows it to leak out the bottom.
steps: Plan ahead: the cheesecake discs must spend at least 1 hour in the freezer, plan this time before shaping the cookies.
Work the cream cheese with the vanilla extract until you obtain a smooth cream, without lumps.
Place ten small spoonfuls of cream on a lined baking sheet. Aim for discs of approximately 3 cm, slightly flattened.
Place the sheet in the freezer for at least 1 hour. The discs must be hard to the touch.
Cream the soft butter with both sugars (beat them together until the mixture whitens and lightens). Add the egg and vanilla flavour, mix.
Pour in the flour and finish with a spatula, without overworking. The dough should remain soft and slightly sticky.
If it is too sticky to shape, refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 160 °C. Spread a third of the dough flat on the work surface and scatter small dots of strawberry spread over it, spaced apart.

Fold the dough over itself two or three times to marble (create veins of colour without mixing completely). Stop as soon as the red streaks appear: beyond that, everything turns a uniform pink. Repeat with the remaining dough.
Divide into ten portions. Flatten each one in the palm of your hand, place a frozen cheesecake disc in the centre, close and roll (see the titanium gesture).
Place the balls on the sheet, well spaced apart, and bake for 12 minutes. The edges should be set, the centre still pale and soft.

On removal, place a few dots of strawberry spread on top and stretch them with the tip of a knife if the marbling lacks definition. Leave to cool for 10 minutes on the sheet before transferring to a wire rack.

title: Nectarine mousse, speculoos cookie pieces
intro: It all depends on the firmness of the egg whites: if they are too soft, the foam will release water after an hour.
titane: Heat a dry titanium pan over medium heat, without any oil or butter. Add the roughly broken speculoos cookies and stir for a minute or two, until the butter and brown sugar in the cookies release their aroma. Remove from the pan (immediately transfer to a cold plate): on the hot metal, the crumbs would continue to cook and turn bitter. This quick toasting dries them out and keeps them crisp beneath the foam.
steps: Rinse the nectarines under running water, dry them, cut them in half and remove the pits. Cut the flesh into pieces.
Blend until you obtain a smooth purée. If you have kept the skins, push the purée through a sieve with the back of a ladle: the mousse will be finer.
Take three tablespoons of puree and set them aside for plating.
Whisk the remaining puree with the Greek yogurt until the mixture is smooth and free of streaks.
Whisk the egg whites with a pinch of salt. As soon as they foam, gradually add the vanilla sugar and continue whisking until stiff peaks form (the tip barely falls back when you lift the whisk).

Loosen the yogurt mixture with a third of the egg whites, whisking vigorously. Add the remaining egg whites in two batches, using a spatula, cutting and then folding from underneath. Stop as soon as the mixture is smooth.
Toast the speculoos as described above, then crumble them by hand once cooled.
Distribute the crumbs at the bottom of four verrines, coat with a drizzle of reserved puree, then garnish with mousse using a piping bag or a spoon.
Refrigerate for 2 hours and 30 minutes. The mousse will then hold its shape without collapsing. In a hurry, serve immediately: the texture is more fluid, the taste the same.

title: Cottage cheese ice cream, no sugar added
intro: It all comes down to freezing: a mass frozen flat, without air pockets, gives a smooth texture when churned.

ing.note: or honey, according to your taste

titane: No cooking required here; the pan stays in the cupboard for the base. Save it for the garnish: slivered almonds or crushed pistachios tossed into a dry titanium pan over medium heat, stirring constantly until golden brown and fragrant. Remove from heat (immediately transfer to a cold plate) to stop the browning, then let cool before scattering over the ice cream.
steps: Plan ahead: the ice cream freezes for one night, 8 hours minimum, before running through the machine.
Mix the soft cheese and stevia in a bowl until the sweetener is completely dissolved. Taste it: the mixture should seem slightly too sweet, as cold reduces the perception of sugar.
Pour into a freezer-safe container. Smooth the surface with a spatula, making sure it is completely level, and close.
Freeze for one night, 8 hours minimum. The block must be completely frozen through to the center, with no soft spots.
Insert the container into the machine and run the frozen yogurt or lite ice cream program. Stop when the texture is creamy and homogeneous.
If the mixture still comes out powdery or grainy, add one tablespoon of milk and run another mix cycle.

title: Sugar doughnuts
intro: It all comes down to the oil temperature: too low, the dough absorbs the fat; too high, it browns before it is cooked through.
titane: No immersion. Pour 1.5 cm of oil into the titanium pan, no more, and maintain it between 165 and 170°C (a small piece of batter should rise to the surface in three seconds, sizzling clearly). The doughnuts cook on the surface, not floating: a maximum of three at a time to prevent the temperature from dropping, turning them only once halfway through cooking. You will get a light ring around the edge, a sign that the batter has risen properly in the oil.
steps: Plan ahead: the dough rises for 1 hour 30 minutes, then the shaped doughnuts rise for another 30 minutes; factor in this time before serving.
Dissolve the yeast in lukewarm milk. Whisk briefly and let rest for 10 minutes, until a fine foam forms on the surface.
Combine the flour, caster sugar, vanilla sugar and salt in a bowl. Mix dry so the salt does not come into direct contact with the yeast.
Make a well, crack the eggs into it, then pour in the yeast mixture. Bring together by hand until there is no more free flour.
Knead for 5 minutes on the work surface. The dough will remain sticky at this stage, which is normal: do not add flour.
Incorporate the softened butter in small pieces, one at a time. Knead for another 5 minutes, until the dough no longer sticks to your fingers and stretches without tearing.
Cover with a cloth and let rise (first proof) for 1 hour 30 minutes at room temperature, until doubled in volume.
Deflate the dough with a quick palm push, roll it out to 1.5 cm thickness and cut out discs with a cutter. Let them rise for 30 minutes on floured baking paper.
Heat the oil in the pan. Place the doughnuts, risen side down, and cook for 2 minutes per side until dark golden brown.
Remove from the heat onto absorbent paper for two minutes, no more.
Roll them in sugar while they are still warm: it adheres better to a warm surface.

title: Creamy chicken and spinach lasagna
intro: It all comes down to the color of the chicken: a white sauce made with well-set juices is nothing like an ordinary béchamel.

ing.note: (allow 9 to 12 depending on the size of the dish)

titane: Heat the pan empty for 2 to 3 minutes before adding the oil. Place the marinated chicken in the pan, then leave it alone: it will stick at first, then release on its own once a crust has formed. This is the signal, not a timer. All the sauce will then develop in the same pan, on top of these juices. Only the assembly and browning require a dish and an oven.
steps: Mix the chicken strips with the spice blend, garlic powder, coriander, paprika, parsley, salt and pepper. Let the flavors infuse while you prepare the rest, for at least 15 minutes.
Heat the pan empty for 2 to 3 minutes over medium-high heat, then pour in the olive oil.

Spread the chicken in a single layer, without overlapping. Let it color without stirring. When it releases from the pan on its own, flip it, finish cooking and remove from the pan (take it out and set aside).
Peel the onion, then slice it finely. Lower the heat to medium, add the onion to the pan and stir until it becomes translucent, scraping up the browned bits.
Add the butter, let it melt, then sprinkle with flour. Stir for one minute: the roux should lose its raw flour smell without browning.
Pour in the milk in three additions, whisking after each addition until the texture comes together. The sauce should remain smooth.
Stir in the tomato paste, adjust the seasoning and let thicken at a gentle simmer, stirring, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Off the heat, add the cream and mix. Return the chicken and its juices, coat well, then transfer everything to a bowl.

Rinse and drain the spinach. Put the pan back on the heat and cook the spinach gently (cook it slowly so it releases its water) for 5 minutes. Drain it and press it: any remaining water would soften the dish.
If your sheets are not pre-cooked, blanch them for a few minutes in boiling salted water according to the package instructions, drain them, then spread them on a cloth.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. In the dish, alternate lasagne sheets, chicken sauce, spinach and grated cheese. Finish with a generous layer of sauce and the remaining cheese.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the surface is golden and the edges are steaming gently. Let rest for 10 minutes before cutting: the layers will hold together.

title: Peanut butter sandwich cookies
intro: It all comes down to the baking: take the biscuits out when they are barely colored, they will finish setting on the baking sheet and keep the soft center that holds the filling.
titane: The fork imprint isn't decorative. It flattens the dough ball to the desired thickness and creates grooves that conduct heat to the center: without it, the fat-rich dough spreads out and cooks from the edges. Press once in one direction, then once in a cross shape, without forcing it so much as to crack the edges.
steps: Melt the butter over low heat, remove from heat. Incorporate the peanut butter and sugar, work with a spatula until you obtain a smooth and shiny mixture.
Add the eggs one by one, thoroughly combining the first before introducing the second. Flavor with vanilla.
In a second bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, bicarbonate and baking powder. Mix dry to distribute the leavening powders.
Pour this mixture in three additions onto the peanut preparation. Mix just enough so that no flour remains visible: the dough must remain supple.
Cover and reserve in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. The dough must firm up without becoming brittle.
Preheat the oven to 165°C. Take balls the size of a large walnut, space them widely on a tray lined with parchment paper.
Flatten each ball with the back of a fork, in a cross pattern, to about 1 cm thickness.
Bake for 13 to 15 minutes. The edges color, the center remains pale and supple. Let rest for 5 minutes on the tray before transferring to a rack and cooling completely.
For the filling, work the peanut butter with the icing sugar. Loosen with milk, one spoonful at a time, until you have a smooth cream that holds with a whisk without running. Add the vanilla.
Turn over half the biscuits, place a good spoonful of cream in the center, top with the second biscuit and press gently until the filling is flush with the edge.

title: Blueberry and lemon chia pudding
intro: It all comes down to the proportion of seeds to liquid: too much chia and the pudding becomes compact, not enough and it remains a soup.
ing: The finely grated zest of an untreated lemon
titane: Dry-fry half the blueberries in a very hot titanium pan for two minutes, without any oil. The skins will burst, the juice will concentrate and lose its watery quality. Remove from the heat and transfer to a cold container immediately to stop the cooking process: the fruit should be lukewarm, not candied. This is what gives the pudding its deep color and a true blueberry flavor, rather than a diluted one.
steps: Plan ahead: the pudding must rest in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Heat the titanium pan over high heat. Pour 125 g of blueberries and let them burst for 2 minutes, stirring once. Transfer to a bowl and let cool slightly.

Blend the cooked blueberries with the remaining raw fruits, coconut milk, maple syrup, lemon zest and juice. Stop as soon as the mixture is smooth: over-blending heats the coconut milk and causes it to split.
Pour the chia seeds into the mixture. Whisk for about thirty seconds, wait 5 minutes, then whisk again. This second pass breaks up the lumps that always form during the first swelling.
Divide between two jars, cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 4 hours, ideally overnight. The texture should be thick and creamy, the spoon should stand upright without any difficulty.
Loosen with a teaspoon of coconut milk before serving if the pudding has set too firmly.

title: Savory red lentil muffins
intro: No flour here: it is the soaked raw lentils, blended very finely, that make up the whole structure, and the success lies in the fineness of this mixture (basic blend).

ing.note: soaked for a minimum of 4 hours

titane: The vinegar is added last, just before baking. It activates the baking soda, the mixture rises and loosens under the spatula: from this point, you have two minutes to fill the molds and close the oven. Batter left on the work surface will deflate and result in dense muffins.
steps: Plan ahead: the lentils should soak for at least 4 hours, or even overnight; start in advance.
Cover the lentils generously with cold water. Leave to soak for 4 hours, or overnight in the refrigerator. They should break under your fingernail.

Drain them, rinse them. Peel the garlic, then blend the lentils with the cold water, garlic and salt. Process at length, scraping down the sides: aim for a perfectly smooth batter with no grittiness under your finger. Allow two to three minutes depending on your blender.
Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Oil a muffin tin, twelve cups.
Pour the batter into a bowl. Fold in the spices, flax seeds, grated carrot, chives and baking powder. Mix gently with a spatula, without overdoing it.
Add the bicarbonate of soda, then the vinegar. Mix for five seconds: the batter lightens and becomes covered with fine bubbles.
Divide immediately into the cups, filling three-quarters full. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes, until the surface is golden and firm to the touch. A skewer inserted in the centre comes out dry.
Let cool in the tin for 10 minutes before turning out: the crumb finishes setting as it cools.

title: Strawberries, watermelon and cherry tomatoes, buffalo mozzarella
intro: It's all about temperature and salt: fruits and vegetables should be very cold, mozzarella should be taken out of the refrigerator ten minutes beforehand, and seasoning should be added at the very last moment so that nothing releases water.

ing.note: half a small watermelon, or a quarter

titane: Dry-roast the pistachios in the titanium pan over medium heat, without any oil. Two minutes is all it takes: stir continuously, remove from the pan as soon as they start to smell, and transfer them immediately to a cold plate (removing them from the pan stops the cooking process). The titanium pan maintains a consistent heat, allowing the pistachios to brown without burning, and giving them a satisfying crunch that the salad lacks.
steps: Roast the pistachios using the method described above, then roughly crush them under the blade of a knife.
Hull the strawberries and cut them into quarters. Cut the cherry tomatoes in half.
Scoop out balls of watermelon with a melon baller, or cut it into 2 cm cubes. Remove any visible seeds and drain the balls for a few minutes on absorbent paper.
In a bowl, whisk the vinegar with a pinch of salt until dissolved, then slowly drizzle in the olive oil while stirring to make the vinaigrette (bind the oil and vinegar into a smooth mixture).
Arrange the sprouts at the bottom of a shallow dish. Place the watermelon, tomatoes, strawberries on top, then the mozzarella, torn by hand into large pieces.
Season with salt and pepper, then sprinkle with pistachios, chopped mint, and basil at the last minute. Drizzle with vinaigrette and serve immediately.

title: Fennel, cucumber and apricots with feta
intro: It all comes down to how thinly you cut the fennel: if it's too thick, it remains tough and overpowers the rest.
titane: Before assembling, toast the pistachios in a dry titanium pan over medium heat for two minutes, stirring constantly. They should heat through, not brown. Transfer them (remove them immediately from the pan) to a cold plate: the cast aluminum retains heat and would continue to cook them.
steps: Remove the tough base of the fennel and the first few ribs if they are fibrous. Reserve the green fronds. Thinly slice the bulb (cut it into very thin strips) using a mandoline, crosswise.
Slice the cucumber into 2 mm rounds. Pit the apricots and cut them into quarters, then cut each quarter in half if they are large.
In a bowl, whisk together the olive oil, vinegar and honey until the mixture thickens slightly and stops separating.
Combine fennel, cucumber and apricots in a salad bowl. Crumble the feta by hand into irregular pieces, add the pistachios, the chopped mint at the last minute, the chili salt and the pepper.
Pour over the vinaigrette, mix gently with your fingertips so as not to crush the apricots. Scatter over the fennel fronds and serve.

title: Melon, cucumber and raspberry salad with fresh goat cheese
intro: It's all about the contrasts in texture: the melting melon, the still firm cucumber, the raspberry that gives way under the tooth and the crunching pistachio.

ing.note: mesclun or lettuce, depending on what you have)

titane: Toast the pistachios (heat them dry, without oil, to release their aromas) in the cold titanium pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir constantly. As soon as the aroma rises and the surface browns slightly, transfer them from the pan to a cold plate: the titanium will continue to heat up and would burn the nuts in seconds.
steps: Toast the pistachios as indicated above. Allow them to cool, then roughly crush them with a knife.
Cut the melon in half, remove the seeds with a spoon. Scoop out balls with a melon baller, pressing firmly and twisting a quarter turn: the ball detaches cleanly. Alternatively, cut into 2 cm cubes.
Slice the cucumber into half-centimeter-thick rounds. Thicker than one would instinctively do: this is what keeps it crisp against the melon.
Pit the avocado and slice it thinly within its skin, then scoop out the slices with a spoon so they remain whole.
In a bowl, whisk the balsamic vinegar with a pinch of salt until dissolved, then pour in the olive oil in a thin stream while continuing to beat to obtain a light emulsion, barely bound.
Distribute the greens into two shallow bowls. Arrange the melon, cucumber, avocado, and raspberries in small groups rather than mixing them together. Crumble the fresh goat cheese over top.
Sprinkle with pistachios, season with salt and pepper, add the sliced basil at the last moment, and dress with vinaigrette just before serving.

title: Vegetable mayonnaise with gochujang
intro: Without eggs, the emulsion holds together thanks to the soy proteins: everything depends on the neutrality of the oil and the slowness of the stream.

ing.note: Allow between 250 and 350 ml depending on the outfit

titane: No pan needed here. The container does the job: use a tall, narrow one, just slightly wider than the blender head. Place the blender's bell flat on the bottom, blend without moving it for the first few seconds, then very slowly lift it up. This movement, and this movement alone, is what thickens the sauce (by incorporating air and fat).
steps: Pour this soy milk and gochujang into a tall, narrow container. Blend for 5 seconds to homogenize.
With the blender running, add the oil in a very thin stream along the side of the container. Keep the blender head at the bottom of the container.
When the mixture becomes pale and thickens, raise the blender head in small pulses to incorporate the remaining oil. Allow 30 to 40 seconds to reach a mayonnaise-like consistency.
Add the lemon juice, agave syrup and salt. Blend for a further 5 seconds, taste, and adjust the salt as needed.
Transfer to an airtight jar. The sauce will keep for 4 days in the refrigerator.

title: Cucumber, cherries and mozzarella, roasted pistachios
intro: It's all about contrast: the cucumber must remain crunchy and the cherry ripe, otherwise the dish falls flat.
titane: Heat a titanium pan over medium heat, without any oil or butter. Add the crushed pistachios and stir constantly for two minutes: they should heat through, release their aroma, but never brown. Remove from the pan (transfer immediately to a cold plate) as soon as the aroma becomes strong; residual heat would only make them worse.
steps: Roast the pistachios as described above. Let them cool.
Slice the cucumbers into thin rounds, about 2 mm thick. Keep the skin on if it is tender.
Pit the cherries and cut them in half.
Tear the mozzarella by hand rather than with a knife: the irregular edges hold the seasoning better.
In a bowl, mix the mustard with the vinegar, add the honey, then slowly drizzle in the oil while whisking until the sauce thickens slightly.

Divide the cucumber, cherries, and mozzarella between two shallow bowls. Season with chili salt and pepper, then scatter over the pistachios and torn basil. Drizzle with the sauce just before serving.

title: Sesame soba noodles, chili cucumber
intro: It all comes down to the texture of the sauce: too thick, it sticks the noodles together; thinned with cooking water, it coats them one by one.
titane: Soba noodles are cooked in water in a pot. The titanium pan comes in at the end: dry-fry the crumbled tofu over medium-high heat, without any oil. Spread it in a thin layer, let it brown undisturbed for two minutes, then stir. You're looking for crisp, golden-brown tofu, not lukewarm mush.
steps: In a bowl, whisk together the tahini, soy sauce, gochujang, vinegar, agave, and salt. The paste will initially stiffen: this is normal, continue whisking.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook the soba noodles according to the package directions, usually 4 to 5 minutes. Taste a noodle: it should remain firm in the center.
Remove two tablespoons of the cooking water before draining. Thin the sauce with this liquid until it reaches the consistency of heavy cream.
Rinse the noodles in cold water, drain them thoroughly, then shake the colander. A wet noodle dilutes the sauce.
Dry-fry the crumbled tofu in the titanium pan over medium-high heat for about 4 minutes, until golden brown and dry. Remove from the pan (transfer from the cooking container to stop the heat).
Mix the cucumber with the soy sauce, vinegar, chili flakes and sugar. Let it sit for 5 minutes to release its juices.
Coat the noodles with sesame sauce, arrange in a deep bowl, place the drained cucumber on the side and cover with grilled tofu.

title: Banana, strawberry and dark chocolate bowl cake
intro: It all depends on the ripeness of the banana: it is what sweetens the mixture (the basic blend) and keeps the cake moist after baking.
ing: Protein powder, neutral or vanilla flavor
titane: Once the bowl cake is baked, unmold it and place it for 40 seconds on each side in a dry, hot titanium pan. The surface will firm up, the edges will turn golden, and the contrast with the moist center will completely transform the taste. No oil or butter is needed: the titanium is enough, and the banana's natural sugar will caramelize on its own.
steps: Peel the banana and mash it with a fork in a microwave-safe bowl. Work it until you obtain a smooth puree: banana lumps cook poorly and leave compact areas.
Pour the oat flakes, protein powder and baking powder over the puree. Mix dry first, to distribute the baking powder.
Add the egg and honey. Mix until the mixture is smooth and pliable. It should fall slowly from the spoon without running.
Smooth the surface, then arrange the strawberry slices and chocolate chips on top. Press them in only slightly: they should remain visible after rising.

Microwave on full power for 3 minutes. The cake will rise and then stabilize. Check for doneness with a knife: it should come out clean. If the center remains liquid, microwave in 20-second increments.
Let it rest for 1 minute outside the oven before eating. The crumb will firm up during this time.

title: Miso and ginger mayonnaise
intro: An emulsion made with cooked rather than raw egg yolks: it holds effortlessly, and the miso gives it the depth that lightening it takes away.
titane: No cooking is involved here, but the pan still plays a role: dry-roast a spoonful of white sesame seeds over medium heat. For two minutes, shaking the pan, until they turn golden and pop. Roughly crush them and set them aside for finishing. Titanium heats up quickly and without hot spots: remove from the heat as soon as they reach the desired color, as the seeds will continue to cook throughout.
steps: Place the hard-boiled eggs in the blender bowl with the mustard, vinegar, and salt. Blend until no yolk remains: the base must be perfectly smooth before proceeding.

With the blender running, pour in the two oils in a thin, even stream. The mixture will whiten and thicken: you are creating an emulsion (dispersing the fat into fine droplets stabilized by the yolk). Never pour faster than the sauce can absorb it.
Add the miso, soy sauce, grated ginger, ketchup and stevia. Blend for fifteen seconds, until the miso is completely smooth.
Incorporate the cream cheese last, in short bursts. If blended for too long, it will liquefy the sauce.
Taste. Adjust the seasoning with salt, vinegar, or soy sauce as needed. Transfer to a clean container and refrigerate for one hour: the flavors will meld while resting.

title: Pan-fried chicken tikka masala
intro: It all comes down to two things: pieces of chicken seared before simmering, and yogurt added off the heat so that it binds the sauce without separating the flavors.
titane: Heat the empty pan for two minutes before adding the chicken. On a titanium coating, the meat won't stick, but it will only brown if the surface is thoroughly hot: place the pieces spaced apart, don't touch them for three minutes, then turn them over. The juices that collect at the bottom will form the base of the sauce.
steps: Mix the chicken by hand with the garam masala, ground coriander, cumin, garlic, ginger, and half the salt. Massage the pieces for one minute: the spices should adhere everywhere. Let it rest while you chop the onion.
Heat the pan over high heat. Sear the chicken in two batches, without overcrowding, for three minutes per side. Remove (transfer to a serving dish) and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Sweat the diced onion in the juices for five minutes, until they become translucent.

Add the chopped tomatoes, brown sugar, and the remaining salt. Scrape the bottom of the pan with a spatula to loosen any browned bits. Let the tomatoes simmer (caramelize them slightly) for six to eight minutes, until the mixture darkens and the juices thicken.
Return the chicken and any accumulated juices to the pan. Partially cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 25 minutes. Stir every five minutes.
Remove the lid. If the sauce remains liquid, increase the heat for two to three minutes to reduce it: it should coat the spatula.
Turn off the heat. Wait one minute, then stir in the Greek yogurt in three additions, mixing between each addition. The sauce will turn orange and become smooth.
Adjust the salt. Sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander and serve over rice.

title: Caramel and protein iced latte
intro: It all comes down to temperature: the coffee must be cold before mixing, otherwise the foam will collapse and the protein will granulate.
ing: Dulce de leche flavored whey protein
titane: Before assembling, pour a tablespoon of condensed milk into a dry titanium pan over medium heat. Let it brown without stirring for thirty to forty seconds, until it smells like caramel. Immediately transfer it to a bowl, loosen it with a spoonful of hot coffee, and let it cool. This caramel adds a depth that the powder alone cannot achieve.
steps: Pull the espresso and let it cool to room temperature, or chill it in the refrigerator for ten minutes. Warm coffee will melt the ice cubes before you even serve it.
Combine the cold coffee, almond milk, condensed milk and whey protein in the blender. Add the cooled caramel if you made it.

Blend at medium speed for about fifteen seconds, then increase to full speed for five more seconds. Stop as soon as the surface is covered with a thin and even foam: beyond that point, the protein heats up and loses its smoothness.
Fill a tall glass with ice cubes, pour the latte in a thin stream down the side to preserve the foam. Serve immediately.

title: Peanut and dark chocolate banana bread
intro: Everything depends on the ripeness of the bananas: black-spotted skin, almost candied flesh, otherwise the crumb remains dry and the sugar dominates.
titane: The cake itself requires a covered pan and an oven: a titanium pan won't provide the rising time or ensure the cake is cooked through for 40 minutes. However, dry-roast the peanuts in the pan before you begin (roasting means toasting without oil to develop their flavor). Over medium heat, for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring constantly. The pan heats up quickly and evenly: the nuts will brown from the bottom up, not from spot burning. Remove the peanuts from the pan as soon as they smell toasted; they will continue to cook in the residual heat.
steps: Roast the peanuts in a pan, then let them cool on a plate.
Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F), conventional setting. Line a loaf tin with baking paper (line: cover the inside of the tin).
Peel the bananas and mash them with a fork in a bowl. Leave some pieces whole; they will melt during cooking.
Add the melted butter, peanut butter, eggs and sugar. Whisk until smooth.
Add the cinnamon, vanilla, yeast and flour. Mix with a spatula, stopping as soon as the dough is homogeneous: if overworked, it becomes elastic.
Chop the chocolate with a knife into irregular pieces. Large pieces form melting pockets, small ones disperse.
Incorporate 170g of chocolate and 55g of peanuts into the dough, in two or three movements.
Pour into the mold, smooth the surface, and spread the remaining chocolate and peanuts on top.
Bake in the middle of the oven for 40 to 45 minutes. The knife should come out dry in the center, away from the chocolate area.
Let it cool for 20 minutes in the mold before unmolding and slicing. The crumb will crumble when hot.

title: minced tofu and pickle sandwich
intro: It all comes down to the knife: the ingredients must be chopped together, not separately, so that the juices mix on the board before even reaching the bread.
titane: Toss the bread slices for two minutes in a dry, hot titanium pan, without any added fat. The surface will brown, the crumb will remain soft, and the bread will hold up well to a moist topping without becoming soggy.
steps: Pat the tofu dry with paper towels. Arrange it on the board with the cherry tomatoes, salad leaves, and pickles.
Chop everything with a knife, regularly pulling the mass towards the center with the flat of the blade. Aim for a coarse chop, still legible to the bite: the pieces should remain identifiable.
Add the vegan cream cheese directly onto the pile and give it about ten more knife strokes to incorporate it.
Season with salt and pepper, add the lemon juice. Mix one last time with a blade, then transfer the mixture to a bowl.
Toast the bread dry in the titanium pan, one minute per side.
Top generously, sprinkle with black sesame seeds and serve immediately: the salad loses its crunch in a few minutes.

title: Warm pasta marinated in pickle brine
intro: The still-warm pasta soaks up the brine like a sponge: it is this precise moment, and this moment alone, that makes the recipe.
ing: A few sprigs of dill or flat-leaf parsley
titane: Pasta cooks in a pot of boiling water. But zucchini is best cooked in a titanium pan: thin slices, a very hot pan, and no oil to begin with. Lay them flat and don't touch them for a minute. They should brown before releasing their water. Just a drizzle of olive oil at the very end, off the heat.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to the time indicated on the package, removing it 30 seconds early to keep it firm.
Drain without rinsing. Transfer immediately to a large salad bowl: it must cool slowly and not stick together.
Pour the brine over the hot pasta and mix. It will hiss slightly and absorb the liquid.
Let marinate for 20 minutes at room temperature, stirring once halfway through. At the end, the bottom of the bowl should be almost dry.
Meanwhile, peel the zucchini and cut it into 3 mm slices. Sear them dry in the hot titanium pan, one minute per side, until you get distinct marks. Salt, pepper, and oil off the heat.
Place the zucchini on the marinated pasta. Add the chopped herbs. Taste before adding more salt: the brine has already done part of the work.

title: Chicken fried rice with yum yum sauce
intro: It all comes down to the rice: it must be cooked the day before and very cold, otherwise it sticks and steams instead of frying.
ing: Long grain rice cooked the day before and cooled
titane: Work in two stages, in a single layer. First, the chicken, seared without stirring for the first minute, then removed from the pan and set aside, covered. Next, the rice, spread over the entire surface and left undisturbed for forty seconds before each turning: it is this still contact with the titanium that produces the golden, separate grains.
steps: Plan ahead: the yum yum sauce benefits from resting for thirty minutes in the fridge; prepare it first.
Whisk all the yum yum sauce ingredients in a bowl, adding the water last until you reach the consistency of a pouring cream. Set aside in the fridge: it benefits from resting for thirty minutes.
Crumble the cold rice by hand to separate the grains. Season the chicken strips with salt and pepper.

Heat the titanium pan over high heat, dry, until a drop of water dances on it. Pour in 1 tablespoon of neutral oil, then arrange a third of the chicken in a single layer. Let it sear for 1 minute without stirring, turn over, cook for 1 minute more. Remove. Repeat in two more batches.
Lower to medium heat. Pour in 1 tablespoon of oil, beat the eggs and scramble them coarsely, 1 minute. Remove with the chicken.
Turn the heat back up. Remaining oil, onions and carrots: 4 minutes stirring occasionally, until the first golden edges appear. Add the garlic and ginger, 30 seconds.
Add the rice, spread it over the entire surface. Leave it for 40 seconds without touching, toss with large shovel-like motions, repeat four or five times until the grains jump and crackle.
Pour the soy sauce along the hot edges of the pan rather than in the centre: it caramelizes immediately. Add the peas still frozen, mix for 2 minutes.
Return the chicken and eggs, add the sesame oil and white pepper. Reheat for 2 minutes while stirring. Off the heat, scatter the spring onions over the top.
Serve with the yum yum sauce on the side, drizzle onto the plate at serving time: if mixed while hot, it breaks down.

title: Mango, blueberry and banana smoothie
intro: It all comes down to temperature: the fruit remains frozen until the very last second, which is what gives it a thick texture without ice cubes or dilution.
titane: No pan here, but the same principle applies: nothing is heated. A blender running for a long time heats the mixture and makes it liquid. Work in two short bursts, with the bowl completely cold, and stop as soon as the mixture thickens.
steps: Pour the plant-based milk into the blender bowl, then add the mango and blueberries while still frozen. Add the liquid first: the blades will engage more quickly.
Blend for 2 minutes, gradually increasing the speed. Stop when the mixture is smooth and homogeneous, with no fruit pieces remaining.
Peel the banana, then add it and blend for 1 minute more to combine everything. The texture should coat the back of a spoon.
Serve immediately, in glasses chilled in the freezer if you remember. After ten minutes, the smoothie will start to separate.

title: Vegetable pilaf rice with crispy tofu and spicy ketchup sauce
intro: It all comes down to the tofu crust: a hot pan, pieces that are not touched, and the rest follows.
titane: Tofu is the only ingredient that goes in a pan, and that's where it makes all the difference. Heat the pan dry for 2 to 3 minutes, then pour in a high-smoke-point fat (like grapeseed oil), and place the pieces in the pan, leaving space between them. They'll stick at first, which is normal: a crust is forming. Once it's set, they'll release on their own. Don't force anything before that happens. Rice, on the other hand, stays in a saucepan or rice cooker: its volume of water far exceeds what a pan can handle.
steps: Rinse the rice in cold water at least three times, until the water runs fairly clear. The surface starch washes away, and the grains will remain separate.

Peel the red onion and carrot. In a saucepan, sweat the red onion, carrot and scallion whites over medium heat for 4 minutes. Add the paprika, tomato paste and soy sauce, stir for 1 minute to toast the spices.

Add the drained rice and make it nacre (coat the grains with fat until they become translucent at the edges), 1 minute. Pour in the water, season with salt and pepper, cover and cook over low heat for approximately 20 minutes, until completely absorbed. Remove from heat, let rest for 5 minutes without opening the lid.
Meanwhile, tear the tofu by hand into irregular pieces the size of a walnut. The torn edges catch better than a knife cut.
Mix the tofu with the paprika, salt, pepper, soy sauce and agave syrup. Dust with cornstarch last and gently turn to coat each piece.

Preheat the titanium pan empty for 2 to 3 minutes, then add the oil. Place the tofu in a single layer, without overlapping. Let sear over high heat without touching, 3 to 4 minutes: the pieces will release on their own when the side is set. Turn and repeat on the other sides, 10 minutes total. Transfer onto a plate, not on paper towels which would soften the crust.
Whisk the plant-based yogurt with the ketchup and chilli oil. Thin out with water, one spoonful at a time, until you reach a coating consistency.
Arrange the rice at the bottom of two bowls, place the tofu on top, coat with sauce and scatter the sliced scallion greens over.

title: Individual cheesecakes with cottage cheese and red berries
intro: It all comes down to the cooking: at 150°C, the mixture sets without ever drying out, and it is this still-soft center that gives it the texture.
titane: The cheesecakes are baked in ramekins in the oven; a frying pan doesn't replicate that slow, even setting. Set the rest aside. Sauté half the berries in a dry titanium pan over medium heat for two minutes, until they release their juices and coat the bottom. Transfer them to a cold bowl. You'll have a coulis without added sugar while the cheesecakes cool.
steps: Preheat the oven to 150°C with convection mode.
In the blender bowl, combine the cottage cheese, yogurt, egg, flour and whey. Blend for one minute until you obtain a perfectly smooth mixture with no visible curd grains.
Let rest for two minutes to allow air bubbles to rise. This will prevent craters from forming on the surface.
Divide among three ramekins. Fill three-quarters full, as the mixture will rise slightly.

Bake for 15 minutes. The surface should be set while the center still trembles slightly (it quivers when you shake the ramekin, but is not liquid). If a blade comes out clean, it is already overcooked.
Remove and let cool completely at room temperature. The setting continues outside the oven, and this is where the texture becomes fixed.
Place the ramekins in the freezer for 10 minutes to complete the setting before serving.
Turn out of the ramekins or serve in them. Decorate with halved strawberries and blueberries, drizzle with warm or cold coulis.

title: Chocolate, banana and strawberry ice cream bars
intro: It all depends on the ripeness of the bananas: speckled with brown, they alone sweeten the preparation and give it its creamy texture once chilled.
titane: Melt the chocolate directly in the titanium pan over very low heat, away from any source of steam. The even heat distribution of the titanium prevents the hot spot that would cause the chocolate to seize, and you essentially create a double boiler. As soon as two-thirds of the pieces have melted, remove from the heat and stir: the residual heat will finish the job. While you're at it, toast (dry-roast over low heat to develop their flavor) a handful of peanuts in the same pan before adding the chocolate.
steps: Plan ahead: the bars require 4 hours in the freezer, plan for this time before serving.
Chop the chocolate. Melt it in the titanium pan over very low heat, stirring with a spatula. Remove from heat halfway through melting and smooth it. Let cool for 2 minutes.
Peel the bananas, break them into chunks and place in the blender with the peanut butter, vanilla and salt. Blend for 30 seconds.
Pour the lukewarm chocolate in a thin stream, blender running, and blend until the mixture is perfectly smooth, with no streaks of set chocolate.
Hull the strawberries and crush them roughly with a fork: keep visible chunks, they will provide the contrast.
Transfer the mixture to a thick freezer bag. Add the crushed strawberries, seal while pressing out the air, then knead two or three times only to marble without fully combining.
Lay the bag flat on a tray and spread the mass to 1.5 cm thickness by pressing with the back of your hand. Freeze for 4 hours, until firm and thoroughly frozen.
Remove the tray, slit the bag open with scissors and cut into six bars using a knife dipped in hot water then wiped dry. Serve immediately or wrap the bars individually.

title: Chia pudding with apricots and skyr
intro: It all comes down to resting: two hours in the cold, and the chia seeds go from a liquid puree to a dense cream that holds its shape on a spoon.
titane: No cooking required here; the pan stays in the cupboard. If you'd still like a contrast, place two quartered apricots, cut-side down, in a dry, very hot titanium pan for one minute without touching them. The sugars will caramelize, and the flesh will remain firm. Set them aside for garnish, either warm or cooled.
steps: Plan ahead: the pudding must rest for two hours in the refrigerator to thicken.

Pit the 5 apricots, then blend them with 1 tablespoon of honey until you obtain a smooth puree, without lumps or visible fibres. Taste: depending on the ripeness of the fruit, add the remaining honey.
Pour the chia seeds into the puree. Stir with a whisk for about thirty seconds, then a second time five minutes later: the seeds tend to clump at the bottom, this double stirring distributes them.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. The mixture should thicken to a pudding texture, coating, that holds the mark of the spoon.
Loosen the skyr with a spoon to make it supple, then distribute it at the bottom of four bowls or glasses.
Place the apricot-chia mixture on top, without smoothing: the texture makes the difference in the tasting.
Cut the remaining 2 apricots into quarters, arrange them on top and finish with a drizzle of honey.

title: Frozen mango, raspberry and strawberry smoothie
intro: It all comes down to the proportion of frozen fruit: that's what gives it its thickness, not the sugar or the cream.
titane: Load the blender in this order: liquid first, then fruit, and finally ice cubes. The blades will immediately draw in the almond milk and create a vortex that pulls in the rest. If you blend in the opposite direction, the mixture will trap air pockets, requiring you to blend twice as long for a thinner consistency.
steps: Pour the almond milk into the blender bowl.
Add the mango, raspberries and strawberries, then the ice cubes on top.
Blend for 30 seconds at full power, until you get a smooth, coating texture (that holds on the back of a spoon without immediately running).
If the mixture is still too thick to blend, add 20 ml of almond milk and blend for another 5 seconds. Serve immediately, as frozen fruit will fall apart quickly.

title: Shredded chicken burritos with queso sauce
intro: It all comes down to two steps: chicken simmered long enough to shred on its own, and a final minute in the pan that gives the burrito its crust.
titane: The pan is only used at the very end, on a burrito that's already rolled. Preheat it empty for 2 to 3 minutes over medium-high heat, drizzle in a little oil or butter with a high smoke point, place the burrito seam-side down, and don't touch it. It will release on its own once the crust has formed: that's the signal to flip it. Any attempt to move it beforehand will tear the tortilla.
steps: Place the chicken breasts in a slow cooker. Add the taco seasoning, green chilies, and lime juice. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. The meat should be very tender when pierced with a fork.
Meanwhile, blend the cottage cheese, milk, enchilada sauce, salsa, and taco seasoning until perfectly smooth. Refrigerate.
Drain the chicken, reserving two tablespoons of the cooking liquid. Shred it with two forks, then transfer it (out of its cooking container) to a large salad bowl.
Add the mozzarella, pepper jack, queso sauce, pico de gallo, and cilantro. Mix: the residual heat from the chicken should just begin to soften the cheeses, without making them stringy.
Lay out a tortilla, place 85g of rice in the center, then a generous ladleful of filling. Fold in the sides, roll tightly, finishing with the seam underneath.
Wrap each burrito in aluminum foil or place it in a sealed freezer bag. They will keep for 3 months in the freezer.
To serve, remove the packaging, wrap the burrito in a damp paper towel, and microwave for 5 to 6 minutes. The moisture prevents the tortilla from hardening.
Finish in a preheated titanium pan: 2 minutes per side over medium-high heat, without touching it. Let it rest for 1 minute before slicing diagonally.

title: Chocolate-banana bowls that can be prepared in advance
intro: Three layered breakfasts on Sunday evening, the balance of which depends entirely on the texture of the peanut cream: too firm, it sets in the cold; too liquid, it seeps through the yogurt.
titane: Melt the chocolate in the titanium pan off the heat. Heat it alone for thirty seconds over medium heat, remove it from the heat, then stir in the chopped chocolate and coconut oil. The residual heat of the pan will dissolve everything as you stir with a spatula, being careful not to let the chocolate seize (break into dry grains). You'll end up with a glossy glaze and only one pan to wash.
steps: Whisk the plant-based yogurt with the protein powder and chia seeds. Mix until the powder is completely dissolved, with no lumps at the bottom of the bowl. Let rest for ten minutes: the chia will swell and set the base.

In a second bowl, loosen the peanut butter with the maple syrup, then incorporate the plant-based milk in three additions. Pour a little, mix, and repeat. You are looking for a nappant cream that holds on the spoon before falling back slowly. Between 100 and 200 ml depending on the peanut butter brand.
Peel the bananas, then cut them into half-centimetre slices. Any thinner and they will fall apart after two days.
Heat the titanium pan dry for thirty seconds, remove it from the heat. Add the chopped chocolate and coconut oil, stir off the heat until you obtain a smooth and fluid mass.
Divide the protein base among three airtight containers. Top with peanut cream, arrange the banana slices flat, then coat with melted chocolate.
Close and refrigerate. The chocolate sets into a thin shell that you break with the spoon. Keep for three days.

title: Mini chickpea and oat cookies
intro: Chickpeas replace flour and butter here: what matters is blending them long enough so that no grains remain, otherwise the texture betrays the legume.

ing.note: g, drained and rinsed in clean water
g, or the equivalent of three tablespoons

titane: Before grinding them into flour, toast the oat flakes (dry-roast them to develop their aroma) in a titanium pan over medium heat for three minutes, stirring constantly. As soon as they develop a nutty aroma, transfer them to a cold plate. The cookies themselves are baked in the oven: only radiant heat will ensure these little treats brown evenly.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F), fan setting. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Blend the toasted and cooled oat flakes until you obtain a fine powder, with no visible pieces.
Rinse the chickpeas under cold water, drain them, then dry them in a clean cloth. Residual moisture will make the dough soggy.
Add the chickpeas to the oat flour in the blender bowl. Blend in short bursts until you obtain a smooth and compact mixture.
Stir in the peanut butter and then the maple syrup. Mix again briefly. The dough should pull away from the sides of the bowl and be pliable enough to hold its shape without sticking.
Divide the dough into two bowls. Work the raisins into the first bowl, and the chocolate chips into the second, using a spatula.

Take portions the size of a walnut, roll them into balls, and place them on the baking sheet, spacing them three centimeters apart. Flatten each one with your fingertips to about one centimeter thick: the dough will not spread during baking.
Bake for 12 minutes. The edges should be golden and firm, the center still soft. Let cool completely on a wire rack before tasting: it will firm up as it cools.

title: Double-cooked fries, potato and sweet potato
intro: It all comes down to the dry coating and the initial slow cooking: the fry cooks first, then it becomes crispy.
titane: Heat the frying pan empty for 2 minutes before adding the oil. Place the fries in a single layer, then leave them undisturbed for 3 minutes: a crust will form on contact, and this is what will hold them together during the rest of the cooking process. If you stir them too soon, the starch will stick and the surface will remain pale.
steps: If you wish, peel the potatoes: this is not mandatory, it is a matter of taste. The sweet potato remains unpeeled.
Cut the potatoes and sweet potato into regular sticks with 1 cm thickness. The thinner the stick, the crispier it will be: maintain consistent thickness for even cooking.
Rinse the potato sticks in cold water until the water runs clear, then dry them completely in a cloth. Do not rinse the sweet potato, as it contains little surface starch; simply wipe it.
In one bowl, mix the cornstarch with half the salt and spices. In a second bowl, do the same with the flour.
Coat the potato sticks in the cornstarch, the sweet potato sticks in the flour. Pass each batch through a sieve over the sink to remove excess powder: only a matt film should remain.

Heat the pan over low heat with 1 tablespoon of oil. Place the potatoes in a single layer, cover and cook for 18 to 20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes. The flesh should yield to the tip of a knife without browning.
Transfer onto a rack. Repeat the operation with the sweet potato, 12 to 14 minutes: it cooks faster and sticks more.
Turn the heat to high, pour in 2 tablespoons of oil and wait for it to ripple. Sear the potatoes for 4 to 5 minutes, turning them only once halfway through.
Transfer, then sear the sweet potato for 3 minutes in the remaining oil. It browns quickly, watch the edges.
Salt off the heat, mix the two together and serve immediately: the crispness lasts five minutes, no more.

title: Sweet potato cheesecake
intro: It all comes down to low cooking and slow cooling: this is what gives a dense and creamy mixture rather than a cracked flan.
titane: Remove the cheesecake from the oven when the center is still slightly wobbly when the pan is gently shaken. The cheesecake will finish setting outside the oven due to thermal inertia. A cheesecake baked until completely still will come out grainy and will collapse as it cools.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Pierce the sweet potato in several places, place it on a baking sheet and roast it whole for 60 minutes, until a knife pierces it without resistance.
Split the apple lengthwise and scoop out 400g of flesh. Blend it until perfectly smooth: this is what gives the cake its texture. Let it cool slightly.
Lower the oven to 150°C. Line an 18 x 18 cm square baking tin with baking paper, letting the edges overhang.

Whisk the warm mashed potatoes with the cream cheese until smooth, then incorporate the eggs one at a time, the honey, vanilla, and salt. Mix gently: too much air will cause the mixture to rise and then crack.
Pour into the mold. Place it in a larger dish and fill the latter with very hot water halfway up the sides of the mold (bain-marie: the water tempers the heat and makes it even).
Bake for 50 minutes. The edges should be set, the center still soft.
Turn off the oven, slightly open the door and let the cheesecake cool inside for at least 2 hours. Then refrigerate for 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Remove from mold by pulling on the paper. Drizzle with a little raw honey, sprinkle with pollen, cut into squares with a blade that has been dipped in hot water and wiped between each cut.

title: Strawberry, blueberry and melon smoothie with creatine
intro: The melon acts as a binder, the berries as a colour: blend the fruits while they are still very cold to avoid diluting the glass.

ing.note: that's about one-sixth of a melon, without the peel

titane: No frying pan here. The trick is to follow the blender's loading order: soft fruit at the bottom, ice cubes on top. The blades attack the pulp first, then the ice, and the texture remains smooth without any grey foam.
steps: Cut the melon into 2 cm cubes. Rinse the berries and dry them on paper towels: residual water will dilute the smoothie.
Place the melon, strawberries and blueberries in the blender bowl. Add the creatine and lemon juice, then the ice cubes last.
Pulse for 10 seconds, then blend continuously until the mixture is smooth, with no ice shards or powder grains remaining.
Pour into a large glass, leaving three fingers of space at the top.
Top up with sparkling water poured along the side of the glass. Stir only once with a long spoon to keep the bubbles. Drink immediately: creatine will settle to the bottom if the glass sits.

title: Baked mille-feuille potatoes
intro: It all depends on the thickness of the slices: too thin, they dry out; too thick, the layers do not bond.

ing.note: a clove of garlic, finely grated

titane: Before stacking, press the coated slices between your palms to expel any air. The starch and oil act as a binder: the layers hold together during baking and the mille-feuille unmolds in one piece, crispy on the edges, melting in the center.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Lightly grease the cavities of a muffin tin, or line a baking sheet with baking paper.

Wash the potatoes without peeling them. Slice them into 2mm rounds using a mandoline, with the blade properly adjusted and the finger guard in place. When using a knife, take your time: consistency is more important than speed.
In a large bowl, combine the oil, grated garlic and salt. Whisk for a few seconds to disperse the salt.
Pour the potato slices into the bowl. Mix by hand, lifting from the bottom, until each side is shiny. Never rinse the potatoes beforehand: the surface starch acts as a binder.
Stack the discs tightly in the mold cavities, up to the rim. On a baking sheet, stack them 2 cm high and space them two fingers apart.
Lightly salt the tops. This last pinch doesn't penetrate, it stays in the mouth.
Bake for 45 minutes. The top edges should be a deep golden brown, and a knife inserted into the center should slide in easily. If the top is browning too quickly, loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Let it rest for 5 minutes in the mold before unmolding with a small spoon. The batteries will firm up and come away cleanly.

title: Almond and peanut cookie dough balls
intro: A cookie dough that can be eaten raw without any qualms: no flour, no egg, and a texture that depends entirely on the cold.
titane: Dry-roast the almond flour (without oil) in a titanium pan over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. It should turn golden and smell toasted, not brown. Immediately transfer it from the pan to a cold plate; if left in the hot pan, it will continue to cook and become bitter. Wait until it reaches room temperature before adding it, otherwise the skyr will curdle.
steps: Plan ahead: the dough rests for a minimum of 30 minutes in the refrigerator before being shaped into firm balls.
Toast the almond powder as indicated above. Leave it to cool completely.
In a bowl, work the skyr and peanut butter with a spatula until the mixture is perfectly smooth, with no white streaks.
Pour the syrup. Mix again.
Incorporate the cooled almond powder in two additions. Mix until you obtain a supple dough that pulls away from the sides of the bowl.
Break the chocolate with a knife into irregular shards — the uneven pieces melt differently in the mouth, which is the whole advantage compared to calibrated chips. Fold them in.
Shape balls the size of a walnut between your slightly damp palms. This will take about 5 minutes.
Reserve in the refrigerator for a minimum of 30 minutes. The dough must be firm to the touch before being served.

title: Protein-rich bread
intro: A very hydrated dough loaded with protein: everything depends on the duration of the rising times and the steaming during the first fifteen minutes.
titane: Just before putting the bread in the oven, pour a glass of boiling water into a metal dish placed on the oven floor. This steam (dense vapor trapped inside the oven) keeps the crust soft long enough for the bread to finish rising, then it evaporates and the crust browns instantly. Without it, the oven door closes and the crumb remains dense.
steps: Plan ahead: the dough rises for two hours then one hour thirty after shaping, making three hours and a half of rest in total.
Dissolve the yeast in lukewarm water, let it reactivate for two to three minutes. Pour in the quark, then all the powders and salt.
Knead with a mixer: 5 minutes on first speed to bring together, then 5 minutes on medium speed. The dough should be smooth, elastic, slightly sticky to the touch without sticking to it.
Cover the bowl and let it rise 2 hours at room temperature. The dough should nearly double and show bubbles on the surface.
Give a series of folds (stretch one edge upward, fold it to the center, turn a quarter turn, repeat four times). A single series is sufficient if the rise has worked well.
Shape into a ball on a barely floured work surface, rolling the dough towards you to tighten the surface. Place on a sheet of parchment paper, cover, let it rise 1 hour 30.
Preheat the oven to 230 °C. Dust the bread with flour, score it (a sharp incision with a cutter or razor blade, held almost flat). Bake with steam for 15 minutes.
Lower to 200 °C, remove the water pan and continue for 25 to 30 minutes. The bottom should sound hollow.
Transfer (move off the baking sheet) onto a rack and let it cool completely before cutting. Cut while warm, the bread will compact.

title: Sweet potato crispy cereal
intro: It's all about the moisture: a very cold puree, well drained of its steam, and the flakes will dry out instead of softening.

ing.note: mashed (i.e., a nice raw sweet potato)

titane: Press the dough firmly onto the baking sheet with the back of a spatula until you obtain a compact slab 1 to 1.5 cm thick. This compression will produce crisp pieces when broken, not oat dust.
steps: Plan ahead: the sweet potato purée must cool for at least 30 minutes, preferably overnight, before being mixed with the flakes.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the whole sweet potato on a baking sheet and roast for approximately 50 minutes, until a blade enters it without resistance.
Split it open, scoop out the flesh with a spoon and blend it into a smooth purée. Transfer to a wide dish: the more spread out the purée, the faster it loses its steam.
Refrigerate for a minimum of 30 minutes, preferably overnight. The purée must be cold and firm before the next step.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Mix the cold purée with the oat flakes, melted butter, 40 g of honey, vanilla and salt. Work until no dry flakes remain.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the dough into a rectangle and press it firmly to a thickness of 1 to 1.5 cm.
Bake at 180 °C for 22 minutes. The slab must be set and barely golden.
Remove the sheet from the oven. While still warm, break the slab into irregular pieces, drizzle with the remaining honey and mix gently with a spatula, without crushing.
Return to the oven for 20 minutes at 180 °C, stirring every 5 to 10 minutes. Stop when the color is deep golden and the pieces sound dry under the spatula.
Let cool completely on the baking sheet. The crispness forms during this cooling, not in the oven. Store in an airtight jar.

title: Cocoa and almond mug cake
intro: An individual cake that stands upright in seven minutes: it all comes down to stopping the cooking; a few seconds too long and the crumb becomes rubbery.
titane: Melt the coconut oil over very low heat in the titanium pan, removing it from the heat as soon as it's liquid. Pour it into the mug, wait ten seconds, then crack the egg onto it: the oil, still warm but not hot, prevents the egg white from curdling and ensures a smooth batter. The pan is used here as a melting pot, not a cooking surface.
steps: Melt the coconut oil over low heat, then pour it into a mug of approximately 25 cl. Let it cool slightly.
Break the egg into the mug and beat with a fork until the mixture is homogeneous.
Add the water or milk and thin out the batter (soften the mixture with the liquid) while continuing to beat.
Stir in the almond protein all at once, then the cocoa and agave syrup.
Mix for forty seconds, scraping the bottom and sides: there must be no pockets of dry powder remaining. The batter should coat the fork without dripping in streams.
Microwave for 1 min 30 at 900 W. Check: the top should be set but still slightly moist in the center. If needed, extend in 15-second intervals, no longer.
Let rest for one minute outside the microwave. Cooking finishes on its own during this time.

title: Sweet potato brownie-cheesecake bars
intro: It's all about temperature: a very cold sweet potato puree gives a dense base, and each layer must be set before receiving the next.
ing: fleur de sel for the finishing touch
titane: The ganache is made in the titanium pan over the lowest heat setting. The thick base distributes heat evenly: the chocolate melts without ever reaching the point where it seizes. Stir continuously with a spatula, from the center outwards. If your pan is very hot even at the lowest setting, place a bowl in the pan with two centimeters of simmering water and work in a double boiler.
steps: Wash the sweet potatoes and prick them all over with a fork. Bake them whole at 200°C (180°C fan-assisted) for 45 to 60 minutes. They are ready when a knife inserted into them meets no resistance.

Split the tomatoes, scoop out the flesh, weigh out 260g, and mash it with a fork until you have a smooth purée with no visible fibers. Let it cool, then refrigerate for several hours, ideally overnight. This step is crucial for the base to set properly.
